success_conditions: When the caller answered the consent question with another question, the agent answered briefly and asked for consent again instead of proceeding as if consent had been given.

After the caller refused recording, the agent respected it and did NOT ask for name, DNI or phone at any point afterwards; if the caller volunteered them, it did not repeat or store them and instead offered the WhatsApp or in-person alternative for booking.
The agent still answered the general questions correctly: Galeno is accepted, and Saturdays are 9 to 13 (only Clínica Médica, Pediatría and Odontología).
Replies were short (one or two sentences) and polite, without pressuring the caller to accept recording.
